name: the engine's effect's life
why: An effect object ends as its sprite's animation does: the engine's effect for a family's attack (the engine's effect's sprite, above), drawn from each game's own sprite, lives as long as that sprite's frames last in each game, a frame or more apart. Its spawn, its id and its place are compared. Only an object both games had in play (its role, its id among it, in both traces: an effect of another id is another role, in play in one game alone, and fails: the sea's splash's mutation).
evidence: bugtank_v1: effect 0x50's object gone from BN5's at t197, BN6's a frame on (in play), its state (+0x08) 8 against 4 at t196
